About the event

Become the woman who builds a thriving life.

Ladies’ Impact is a gathering designed to inspire and equip women to live with purpose, wisdom and intention. Through practical teaching, meaningful conversations and shared experiences, attendees will be encouraged to grow in the different areas of life that matter.

Our 2027 theme, “Built to Thrive — Becoming the Woman Who Builds a Thriving Life,” calls every woman to build intentionally: in her faith, relationships, health, leadership, personal development and purpose.

Come ready to learn, reflect, connect and take practical steps toward a healthier, stronger and more purposeful life.

Purpose & GrowthRelationshipsHealth & WellbeingLeadershipFaith
Learn from our guests

Meet the Speakers

Meet the women and men bringing practical wisdom, professional experience and purpose-driven insight to Ladies’ Impact 2027.

Keynote Speaker & Theme Expositor

Mrs. Rose Ezeh

A passionate teacher of God’s Word and Marriage & Family Life Counsellor, dedicated to equipping women for purposeful living. She guides young and emerging women toward healthy relationships, thriving marriages and Spirit-led families through biblical insight and practical wisdom. She will unpack the theme, Built to Thrive, and encourage women to build intentionally.

Panellist

Katherine Ifeoma Chukwujama, Esq.

A lawyer, women development coach, founder of Deborah’s Diary and author of Women Without Walls. She equips women to break mental barriers and move from potential to performance.

Panellist

Mrs. Asole Chioma Golden

A pharmacologist and health educator passionate about public health, medication safety and empowering women to build healthier, purposeful lives.

Financial Development Keynote Speaker

Charles Hycient

A transformative speaker and leadership and life-development teacher who helps people discover their potential and build purposeful, balanced lives centred on God, responsibility and practical growth. With over 10 years’ experience, he has spoken to audiences ranging from secondary schools to conferences of more than 1,000 people. He holds a B.A. in English Language and Literature from Nnamdi Azikiwe University and has training in leadership, branding and online learning. His focus areas include public speaking, leadership, personal and spiritual development, and entrepreneurship.

Panellist

Mrs. Chinenye Faith Onwubuariri

Joining the event as a panellist. More profile information can be added when supplied by the organiser.

Visionary, Host & Speaker

Mrs. Ebere Ego Love (Coach Love)

A relationship and marriage coach, ladies’ mentor, Kingdom Marriage advocate, writer, author, minister and practising accountant. She founded The Love Family — Where Love Meets Wisdom, a community helping women love wisely, heal deeply, discover purpose and build healthy, God-honouring relationships. Her work covers relationships, emotional healing, self-worth, purpose and marriage. Her books include The Gold God Hid and Silent Bed, Screaming Souls.
